We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1001) to the molecule given. The molecule is from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 answer: a list of lists each containing a single SMILES? Actually answer: "[['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'], ['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'], ['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C']]"

So there are three possible target molecules? Actually these are three SMILES each in separate inner list. The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below". So we need to apply template_id 1001 to each of those target molecules, get precursors combos.

We need to use apply_template tool. Provide molecule_smiles and template_id. It will return possible outcomes (precursors). Likely returns list of lists of SMILES.

We need to apply to each of the three SMILES. Let's do that.
